HOME_HERO_TITLE: Naturally fermented soup mix inspired by traditional tarhana
HOME_HERO_SUBTITLE: Ready in minutes. No additives. Made in Sweden.
HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC: Tarhana is a traditional fermented soup made from yogurt, grains and vegetables. Slowly prepared for depth of flavor, it has a warm, savory taste with a gently tangy finish — then dried so it can be cooked in just a few minutes.
HOME_PREPARE_INTRO: Tarhana is at its best as a warm, rich soup. Start with the classic — and then top to taste.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP1: 1. Boil 250 ml of water per 2 tablespoons of tarhana.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP2: 2. Whisk in the tarhana and simmer for 5–10 minutes until the soup becomes smooth and creamy.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP3: 3. Serve warm with olive oil, black pepper, herbs or a dollop of yogurt.
HOME_PREPARE_NOTE: Feel free to try with vegetable broth for a deeper flavor.
HOME_VERSATILE_DESC: Tarhana is best known as a warm and satisfying soup — but it can also be used in several other ways in the kitchen.
HOME_VERSATILE_SOUP_DESC: The classic, comforting bowl — quick to make and easy to love.
HOME_VERSATILE_SAUCE_DESC: Whisk tarhana into sauces or stews for more richness and umami.
HOME_VERSATILE_BOWLS_DESC: Top grains, vegetables or beans with a warm tarhana base.
HOME_VERSATILE_QUICK_DESC: A simple shortcut to a flavorful, satisfying weeknight meal.
HOME_PRODUCTS_DESC: Choose your favorite blend and start your tarhana journey today.

STORY_HERO_DESC: The story of Tarhana—from a grandmother's kitchen in Anatolia to the minimal tables of Scandinavia.
STORY_LEGACY_P1: It began in a sun-drenched kitchen, where the scent of fermenting grains and yogurt filled the air. My grandmother didn't just make soup; she crafted a lifeline of nutrition that would last through the harshest winters.
STORY_LEGACY_P2: The process was a rhythmic dance of patience—mixing, fermenting, drying, and crumbling by hand. It was the original 'slow food,' born from necessity and perfected through love.
STORY_SEARCH_P1: Years later, as a mother in Sweden, I found myself searching for that same authentic nourishment. I wanted my children to have the clean, probiotic-rich foundation I grew up with, but in a way that fit our modern, fast-paced Nordic lifestyle.
STORY_SEARCH_CLEAN_DESC: Only natural, organic ingredients. No additives.
STORY_SEARCH_PRAC_DESC: Nutritious meals ready in minutes, not hours.
STORY_BRIDGE_TITLE: Bridging Tradition and Modern Nordic Life
STORY_BRIDGE_P1: Tarhana is our bridge. It combines the ancient wisdom of fermentation with the clean minimalism of Scandinavian design. It is complex in flavor yet simple in preparation.
STORY_BRIDGE_P2: We've taken the core of this tradition and refined it for the health-conscious Swedish family. It's more than just a product; it's a piece of heritage, re-imagined for today.
STORY_PROCESS_QUOTE: Fermentation is a conversation between time and nature.
STORY_PROCESS_DESC: We honor this conversation by never rushing. Our Tarhana undergoes a long, natural fermentation process that develops its signature tangy profile and boosts its nutritional availability.
STORY_FINAL_P: We invite you to bring this warmth into your home. A taste of tradition, a touch of Nordic clarity, and a commitment to pure, simple nourishment.
HEALTH_SUBTITLE: The power of fermentation for your modern lifestyle.
HEALTH_PROB_DESC: Our 21-day fermentation process creates a rich environment for beneficial bacteria, supporting gut health and your immune system.
HEALTH_PROT_DESC: With 18g of plant-based protein per serving, Modern Tarhana is an excellent fuel for an active lifestyle.
HEALTH_CLEAN_DESC: No preservatives, no additives, no artificial flavors. Just organic ingredients and the magic of fermentation.
HEALTH_SLOW_DESC: We don't rush perfection. Each batch is fermented for exactly 21 days in Swedish organic barns to ensure maximum nutrient density.
